name: OCI NoSQL Pattern
summary: Design, implement, refactor and audit Oracle NoSQL Database Cloud Service access patterns: shard and primary keys, indexes, continuation, same-shard transactions, consistency, TTL, IAM, encryption, replicas, metrics, Terraform/DDL/OCI CLI and customer-owned export/import recovery, with command routes that load one guide at a time.
security_notes: Not permission to access OCI. Live reads need a confirmed principal, tenancy, region, compartment and table; writes, load tests and export/import recovery need exact approval. Recovery targets a new table. Bundled scripts are offline route selectors, a date-argument review reminder and a sanitized recovery-manifest checker.
